datasets.title: Sudan Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Sudan Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/sudan_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Sudan to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for each month of 2021, representing the distribution and severity of food insecurity as a loss impact from underlying hazards (primarily drought).

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity severity levels across geographic areas.
